tasks.question: A technician claims that uniformity is assessed by comparing the CT number in the central ROI with the average of the four peripheral ROIs. Is this claim correct according to the procedure described?
tasks.reference_answer: No, uniformity is determined as the absolute difference between the central ROI CT number and each of the four peripheral ROIs individually—not their average.
tasks.rationale: Section (d) explicitly defines uniformity as 'the absolute difference between the CT numbers in the centrally placed ROI and those in each of the four equivalent ROIs near the perimeter', i.e., four separate comparisons. The claim incorrectly substitutes averaging, which is refutable using only the given text.
